setting.label: Syncs TV/movie watch progress (resume points, finished items, watched status) across every device you run this add-on on. Stored in a private GitHub Gist under your own GitHub account -- nothing shared with anyone else, nothing hosted by the add-on's developer.
Use the SAME token on every device you want synced together. Leave the field below blank -- it fills in on its own once sync runs successfully.
Sends crash times and error messages (with logins, addresses and keys removed) so problems can be found and fixed. Nothing else leaves the device.
Error report token (set by the person who made this build)
